sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by fluorescent anti-Myc staining of non-permeabilized cells (cell periphery and cell–cell junction staining observed). Intrinsic cPCDH function not explicitly assayed in the cited clips.
sites.rationale: All three ledger lines (L1–L3) converge on a single site: a Myc tag in the stalk region between EC6 and the TM helix of a full-length, membrane-anchored cPCDH. L1 names the region explicitly; L2–L3 confirm surface display by live-cell anti-Myc staining. No specific residue is stated in any ledger line, so insert_after_residue is left null and the region is recorded. The evidence is indirect for PCDHA1 (the demonstrated construct is γC3/PCDHGC3), but the two proteins share identical domain architecture and the stalk is the structurally equivalent position. Python analysis confirms the stalk spans residues 661–697 (all extracellular per landmarks), with the TM boundary at 698, giving ≥3 residues of clearance for any junction up to ~694. Full-length, membrane-anchored cPCDH constructs (exemplified by γC3/PCDHGC3) were engineered with an extracellular Myc tag placed in the stalk region between EC6 and the transmembrane helix, paired with an intracellular fluorescent protein. Anti-Myc antibody staining of non-permeabilized transfected cells confirmed surface display. The construct design is described as equivalent to previously validated cPCDH constructs. PCDHA1 is a cPCDH alpha-subfamily member sharing the same six-EC-domain + stalk + single-pass TM architecture; the stalk (extracellular residues ~661–697, ≥3 aa from TM boundary at 698) is the orthologous region.

sources.claim: For derived constructs including the myc tag, the tag was positioned in the stalk region between EC6 and the transmembrane helix ( Figure S1A ), equivalently to previously validated constructs ( 21 ).

literature_notes: All three ledger lines derive from the same paper (PMC12157453) and describe the same insertion event in the same region. No second independent site is supported. The evidence is indirect for PCDHA1 specifically (the published tagged construct is γC3/PCDHGC3, a cPCDH gamma member); the stalk-region position is inferred by structural homology within the cPCDH family. No residue is named in any ledger line, so the site is recorded at region level only. The N-terminus (residue 30, after signal-peptide cleavage) is extracellular but no ledger line supports a tag there. The C-terminus (residue 950) is intracellular and excluded. No ledger line names any position that abrogates function or is cytoplasmic.
